title: New covenant
gist: Jeremiah promised a new covenant written on hearts, not on stone (Jeremiah 31). At the Last Supper Jesus calls the cup 'the new covenant in my blood', and Hebrews says he is its mediator. In older English Bibles the same Greek word is translated 'testament', which is why the two halves of the Bible are called Old and New Testament.
original: Hebrew berit hadashah (Jeremiah 31:31); Greek kaine diatheke.

passages.note: Christ the mediator of a better covenant.
